Universal Testing Machine QM-200/300/500/600 Series
QM-200/300/500/600 Series Universal Testing Machines, are floor-type higher capacity models of Qualitest’s popular and budget-friendly QM-Series UTMS and they are available with either M1F configuration with intermediate Controller/Software functions, or the M2F models with advanced controller and further data processing and software features.
 Applications
 Technical Specifications
The models are grouped by Frame Size. Note that the 200kN/300kN share a frame, and the 500kN/600kN share a larger frame.
